prerequisites: The student can include this component in phase 2 or 3 of the program.

learning_outcomes.text: Communicate in a language other than their mother tongue.
Collaborate with people from different cultural backgrounds.

syllabus_topics: Participation in an activity in an international context, such as:
assessment_rules: The grading scale for this course module is 'passed/not passed'. The chosen activity must always be formally approved by the course lecturer BEFORE the activity takes place. The activity must be completed before the last exam of the 2nd examination period (June). The activity will be assessed during a session/discussion with the lecturer on campus. In case of an exchange activity, this course module will be assessed according to the rules and practices of the international partner. If the conditions for passing are not met during one of the semesters, a resit is possible after the last exam of the 2nd examination period (June). The resit activity must be completed before the last exam of the 3rd examination period.
